seo_title: Cost of Living in Goa 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Goa per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: India's main wintering spot for Russian-speaking nomads: long beaches, cheap housing and well-developed infrastructure for remote work. A simple e-visa and a year-round swimming season.
pros: The cheapest oceanside wintering option for Russian speakers
A large Russian-speaking and Western digital-nomad community
Ocean, palm trees and a warm climate from October to April
Well-developed infrastructure for remote work in North Goa
cons: Monsoon season from June to September — rain and many cafés closed
Poor road quality and chaotic traffic
Weak healthcare outside the big clinics in Panaji
Bureaucracy and instability with bank transfers

visa_steps.title: E-Visa
visa_steps.description: An electronic tourist visa for Russian citizens for 30 or 90 days, issued online in 3 days.

visa_steps.title: X-Visa (for families)
visa_steps.description: A long-term visa for those with an Indian spouse or child. Valid for up to 5 years.

visa_steps.title: OCI (for those with Indian roots)
visa_steps.description: An Overseas Citizen of India card — lifelong for those with Indian ancestors.

visa_steps.title: Tax PAN
visa_steps.description: A tax ID is needed for a bank account, renting a villa and buying a long-term SIM card.

visa_steps.title: Bank account
visa_steps.description: HDFC, ICICI and SBI open accounts with a PAN and a long-term lease. Tourists rely on Wise and Revolut only.

faq.question: North or South Goa?
faq.answer: The north (Morjim, Arambol, Assagao) is for nomads — the scene and the infrastructure. The south (Palolem, Agonda) is calmer and quieter.

faq.question: How much is rent in Goa?
faq.answer: A studio in Morjim starts at 35,000 rubles a month, a villa with a pool from 90,000. In high season prices double.

faq.question: When is the best season in Goa?
faq.answer: October to April — dry, +28–32°C. May to September brings monsoons and torrential rain, and many cafés close.

faq.question: What's the internet like in Goa?
faq.answer: Fibre at 100+ Mbps in Morjim and Assagao for 1,500 rubles. Mobile JIO/Airtel 4G is almost everywhere.

faq.question: Is Goa good with children?
faq.answer: There are international schools (Sharada Mandir, EuroSchool) and Russian groups. But healthcare is weak, and complex cases are taken to Mumbai.

faq.question: Is Goa safe?
faq.answer: Petty crime is low, but be careful with water and food at the start of the season. Only rent a scooter with a helmet.

reviews.text: I've been wintering in Goa for 4 years: a villa with a pool in Assagao for 90,000 rubles, the ocean 5 minutes away, friends from the nomad community. The downside is the monsoons and weak healthcare.
I rent a studio in Morjim for 40,000 rubles and work remotely. Russian is spoken in every café, surfing and yoga every day. Goa is a way of life, not a permanent relocation.
